title: Unblemished
summary: UNBLEM'ISHED, adjective 1. Not blemished; not stained; free from turpitude or reproach; in a moral sense; as an unblemished reputation or life. 2. Free from deformity.

inlines.v: UNBLEM'ISHED, adjective 1. Not blemished; not stained; free from turpitude or reproach; in a moral sense; as an unblemished reputation or life. 2. Free from deformity.
